tips.text: Mixing a few high-end pieces with affordable streetwear staples is what gives streetwear its character.
tips.why: Contrast between price tiers looks authentic.

tips.text: Layer hoodies, bomber jackets and longline tees to add depth to a streetwear outfit.
tips.why: Layering is a core streetwear technique.

tips.text: In streetwear the sneakers are the centrepiece: start with clean white pairs, then add statement ones.
Go relaxed in fit, but not so baggy or so tight that it looks unintentional.
An all-black outfit of tee, cargo pants and low-top sneakers is a clean, minimal streetwear base.
A suit worn with a crewneck tee and clean sneakers bridges tailoring and streetwear for smart-casual events.
tips.why: Casual top and shoes soften a suit.

tips.text: A plain hoodie with joggers and clean sneakers works from the gym to a casual evening.

outfits.outfit: jacket navy vintage +windbreaker, tshirt white vintage +graphic, joggers black sporty, sneakers white vintage
outfits.why: Retro graphic tee and track pants feel nostalgic.

outfits.outfit: tshirt black slim minimal, trousers black minimal +cargo, sneakers black minimal +low-top
outfits.why: All-black tee, cargos and low-tops: clean and minimal.

outfits.outfit: hoodie grey oversized sporty, joggers grey sporty, sneakers white sporty
outfits.why: Athleisure that moves from the gym to a casual night.

outfits.outfit: jacket green smart casual +suit, tshirt white minimal, trousers green smart casual +suit, sneakers white minimal
outfits.why: A coloured suit with a crewneck tee and sneakers bridges formal and street.

outfits.outfit: jacket black outdoor +waterproof, tshirt grey sporty, joggers black sporty, sneakers black sporty
outfits.why: A tech jacket over a base layer and joggers is practical.

outfits.outfit: jacket denim oversized streetwear, tshirt white streetwear +graphic, jeans black streetwear +ripped, sneakers white streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Distressed denim and an artwork tee: an expressive street look.

outfits.outfit: zip-hoodie black streetwear, tshirt white streetwear +graphic, jeans denim slim streetwear, sneakers black streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Cuffed jeans, a graphic tee and a zip hoodie feel skater.
